codeExample.title: 내 주변 장소 검색 핵심 로직
codeExample.code:
-- location은 geography(Point, 4326) 열로 저장합니다.
SELECT id, name,
  ST_Distance(location, ST_SetSRID(ST_MakePoint($1, $2), 4326)::geography) AS meters
FROM places
WHERE ST_DWithin(location,
  ST_SetSRID(ST_MakePoint($1, $2), 4326)::geography, $3)
ORDER BY meters, id LIMIT 20;
-- $1 경도, $2 위도, $3 검증된 반경(미터)
